### Task: From Plan to Shop Floor

**Open MES**: In the client, click the "MES" item in the left menu. MES pages are available under the "MES" menu on the left. The first time you open it, select a local plant (the sample plant "Sample Steering Gear Housing Foundry" is recommended; if it is unavailable, click "Create Sample Plant (Local)") → "Start and Open MES". After that, clicking "MES" will automatically start the plant you used last time. The client enables MQTT for this plant, starts the Teaching MES, and imports the equipment and tag list automatically the first time. MES runs only on this computer and stops automatically after 30 minutes of inactivity. All data is retained.

The first step in MES is to turn the plan into an executable **Work Order** for the shop floor.

1. In MES, go to "Production Management → Work Orders" and create a work order: product **SGH-450 Steering Gear Housing**, routing RT-SGH450, planned quantity **≥ 20**, and enter a due date.
2. Click "Release". MES will generate operations and schedule production based on the routing.
3. Return to the virtual factory (use the "Back to Factory" button in the status bar at the top of the MES page) and run it (you can set the speed to 30× or 60×). Then check MES again: the work order status changes to "In Production", **automatic equipment production reports** appear under "Production Reports", and each part's code is visible under "WIP/Serialized Parts".

> Whenever virtual factory equipment finishes a part, it sends a part event to MES over MQTT, and MES automatically reports production. This is "automatic equipment data collection".
工单新建后是「草稿」，一定要点「下达」，否则车间不会按它生产。: A new work order starts as a "Draft". You must click "Release" or the shop floor will not produce against it.

「排产与进度」里能看到每道工序的计划和实际。: View planned and actual values for each operation under "Scheduling & Progress".

工单点了「下达」以后状态是\"已下达\"：车间可以开始做了，但还没有零件报工；等: After you click "Release" on a work order, its status is "Released": the shop floor can start production, but no parts have been reported yet. It changes to "In Production" when the first part is reported.

### Task: Which Machine Is Holding the Line Back?

**Open MES**: In the client, click **MES** in the left-hand menu. MES pages are available from the **MES** menu on the left. The first time you open it, select a local plant (the demo plant "Sample Steering Knuckle Foundry" is recommended; if it is not available, click **Create Demo Plant (Local)**) → **Start and Open MES**. After that, clicking **MES** will automatically start the plant you last used. The client enables MQTT for this plant and starts Teaching MES. Equipment and the tag list are imported automatically the first time. MES runs only on this computer and stops automatically after 30 minutes of inactivity. Your data is retained.

**OEE = Availability A × Performance P × Quality Q**. Availability reflects downtime and changeovers/tool changes, performance compares actual cycle time with standard cycle time, and quality reflects the pass rate.

1. Run the Virtual Factory for at least half an hour of simulation time (at 60× speed, this takes only half a minute). In MES, go to **Equipment Management → OEE Analysis** and review each machine's OEE over the last 2 hours.
2. Find the **machine with the lowest OEE**. Check whether its losses are mainly in A, P, or Q, then open its downtime timeline to see the causes.
3. In **Equipment Management → Repair Orders**, create a **repair order** for this machine and include the main loss you observed in the fault description.

> Grading is based on the OEE over the last 2 hours: your reported machine is correct if it is one of the two lowest (OEE changes during operation).
OEE 分析页可以按 OEE 排序。: You can sort by OEE on the OEE Analysis page.
「设备台账」里点开设备也能报修；维修工单要选设备、写故障描述。: You can also request a repair by opening a machine in the Equipment Register. A repair order must specify the machine and include a fault description.
换刀、换型属于计划内的停顿，但在 OEE 里同样算可用率损失。: Tool changes and changeovers are planned pauses, but they still count as availability losses in OEE.
给 OEE 最低的设备开了维修工单（最近 2 小时最差的两台之一）: Created a repair order for the machine with the lowest OEE (one of the two lowest over the last 2 hours)
某设备 A = 90%、P = 80%、Q = 95%，它的 OEE 是多少（填: A machine has A = 90%, P = 80%, and Q = 95%. What is its OEE? (Enter a decimal, e.g. 0.5)
换刀、换型的时间损失算在 OEE 的哪一项: Which OEE factor includes time lost to tool changes and changeovers?
换刀、换型时设备停着不出活，算在可用率 A 里（属于计划停机）。: When a machine is stopped for a tool change or changeover, it is not producing. This counts toward Availability A (as planned downtime).

### Task: Trace a serialized part to its source

**Open MES**: In the desktop client, click "MES" in the left menu to access the MES page. The first time, select a local factory (the recommended demo is "Steering Gear Housing Foundry"; if none is available, click "Create Demo Factory (Local)") → "Start and Open MES". After that, clicking "MES" automatically starts it for the last factory you used. The client enables MQTT for this factory and starts Teaching MES. Equipment and the tag list are imported automatically on first use. MES runs only on this computer and stops automatically after 30 minutes of inactivity. All data is retained.

Casting defects may originate in melting (the heat or molten iron composition) or machining (the machine tool or cutting tool). MES assigns each part a unique code and records every machine it passes through.

1. Let the virtual factory run until automatically registered nonconformance records appear in MES under "Quality Management → Nonconformance".
2. Select a nonconformance record and note the part code. Enter it under "Production Management → Quality Traceability" to view its **heat**, pouring temperature, **machining equipment**, and inspection results.
3. Return to the nonconformance record. In **Root Cause**, enter its machine ID and heat number (for example: Machine CNC3, Heat H…), then complete its **Disposition** (Rework, Scrap, or Use As Is).

> During grading, MES checks whether the machine and heat entered in the root cause analysis match this part's traceability record.
零件码在不合格品记录的「零件码」一栏；追溯页也可以扫码。: The part code is in the "Part Code" field of the nonconformance record. You can also scan the code on the traceability page.
机床编号和炉次号照追溯页上的原样抄（大小写不要紧）。: Copy the machine ID and heat number exactly as shown on the traceability page (case does not matter).
「正向追溯」从炉次出发，能查到同一炉铁水做出的全部零件。: "Forward Traceability" starts from a heat and finds all parts made from that heat of molten iron.
不合格品的原因分析里写对了加工机床和炉次: Correctly entered the machining equipment and heat in the nonconformance root cause analysis
处置了一张不合格品（返修 / 报废 / 让步接收）: Completed the disposition of a nonconformance record (Rework / Scrap / Use As Is)
要圈定同一炉次铁水做出的全部零件（准备隔离或召回），用哪种追溯: Which traceability method identifies all parts made from the same heat of molten iron for containment or recall?
反向追溯：从零件查它的来源: Backward traceability: Trace a part back to its source
正向追溯：从炉次查零件的去向: Forward traceability: Trace a heat to the parts made from it
从炉次出发去查这一炉铁水做出了哪些零件，是\"正向追溯\"；从一个零件查它的炉次: Starting from a heat to find all parts made from that molten iron is "forward traceability". Starting from a part to find its heat and machine is backward traceability.

### Task: Read a Control Chart

**Open MES**: In the client, click "MES" in the left menu to access the MES pages. The first time, select a local factory (the recommended demo is "Steering Gear Housing Foundry"; if it is unavailable, click "Create Demo Factory (Local)") → "Start and Open MES". After that, clicking "MES" automatically starts it for the last factory used. The client enables MQTT for this factory and starts Teaching MES, automatically importing equipment and the tag list on first use. MES runs only on this computer and stops automatically after 30 minutes of inactivity. All data is retained.

The machining center's probe measures the bore diameter of every part (BORE_DIA, Φ40 +0.025/0 mm). SPC groups every 5 measurements into a subgroup and plots an **X̄-R control chart**:
The process is **stable and in control** only when all points are within the control limits and no nonrandom patterns appear. Any triggered detection rule (a point beyond the control limits, 9 consecutive points on the same side of the center line, 6 consecutive points increasing or decreasing, or 2 out of 3 points beyond 2σ) indicates a special cause.

1. Run the virtual factory until MES has more than 100 bore diameter measurements (run at 60× for a few minutes).
2. In MES, open "Quality Management → SPC Analysis", select the bore diameter characteristic, and review the control chart, flagged points, and Cpk.
3. Answer: Is this process currently stable and in control?

> The first question records your judgment and is not scored on its own. Grading checks your judgment against the MES SPC results (the second criterion).
判异点在控制图上标红；页面下方列出了触发的规则。: Flagged points are shown in red on the control chart. The triggered rules are listed below the chart.
Cpk 高不等于稳定：稳定看排列和控制限，能力看规格限。: A high Cpk does not mean the process is stable: stability depends on patterns and control limits; capability depends on specification limits.
刀具磨损会让尺寸慢慢漂移，常见的是连续多点在中心线一侧。: Tool wear can cause dimensions to drift gradually, often resulting in consecutive points on one side of the center line.
你的判断：缸孔直径过程现在是否稳定受控（本题不计分，按下一项核对）: Your judgment: Is the bore diameter process currently stable and in control? (This question is not scored; it is checked in the next criterion.)
你的判断和 MES 的 SPC 判异结果一致: Your judgment matches the MES SPC rule results
MES 里已有足够的缸孔测量值（≥ 100 个）: MES has enough bore diameter measurements (≥ 100)
控制图上连续 9 个点落在中心线同一侧，说明: What do 9 consecutive points on the same side of the center line indicate?
过程正常，只是随机波动: The process is normal, with only random variation
过程均值可能偏移了，要找原因（比如刀具磨损）: The process mean may have shifted; investigate the cause (such as tool wear)
测量仪器坏了，数据作废: The measuring instrument has failed, so the data is invalid
连续 9 个点落在中心线同一侧，随机波动很难做到，说明过程均值可能偏移了（比如刀: Nine consecutive points on the same side of the center line are unlikely to result from random variation. This suggests the process mean may have shifted (for example, tool wear may be gradually increasing the part dimensions), so investigate the cause.
